catalog_quirks.body: Routes anonymously — the catalog ships a keyless sentinel row and calls work with no account or key.
catalog_quirks.title: No API key required

catalog_quirks.body: Some free routes spend hidden reasoning tokens before visible output. Avoid tiny max_tokens values or requests can finish by length with empty content.
catalog_quirks.title: Needs token room

catalog_quirks.body: OVH AI Endpoints anonymous mode is documented at 2 req/min per IP per model (observed even stricter across models). The 400 req/min authenticated tier requires a Public Cloud project with a payment method, so the catalog ships the keyless path. Treat as a breadth/fallback tier, not a throughput tier.
catalog_quirks.title: Anonymous tier is 2 req/min

catalog_quirks.body: This route returns moderation/safety labels rather than normal assistant prose. Use it as a guardrail model, not a primary chat model.
catalog_quirks.title: Safety classifier output

catalog_quirks.body: OVH Qwen reasoning routes can include <think> blocks or reasoning prose. Strip or suppress the thinking trace when a plain answer is required.
catalog_quirks.title: May emit thinking trace

catalog_quirks.body: Key-tested on September 21, 2026: OVH answers stable-diffusion-xl-base-v10 with model_not_found. Separately, only nine models on OVH AI Endpoints are priced at €0; the rest are reachable solely through the anonymous two-requests-per-minute-per-IP path.
catalog_quirks.title: Route withdrawn upstream
